name: Patrick Kacic
label: Environmental Data Scientist
summary: Data scientist with a focus on environmental data to study ecosystem dynamics, such as forest disturbances, forest structure dynamics, structure-biodiversity relationships.

highlights: Integrating deep learning algorithms for multi-annual forest structure modeling.
Sentinel-2, GEDI, and ALS data processing on HPDA cluster.
Proposal writing, scientific publishing (n=7), student supervision and project administration.
Developed machine learning workflow for multi-annual forest structure prediction using Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, and GEDI data.
Review on forest biodiversity monitoring based on satellite data.
Satellite time-series analyses for forest structure change detection in the context of forest management.
Ground- and spaceborne-based monitoring of forest structure for biodiversity assessment.
Multi-source Earth Observation data processing on HPDA cluster using Python.
Proposal writing, scientific publishing (n=9), student supervision, field work and project administration.
Deforestation monitoring in Paraguay using Sentinel-1 and -2 data.
Python-based time-series analyses in Google Earth Engine.
Organization of training workshop for forest monitoring using satellite data for universitary researchers, federal employees and NGO workers from Paraguay.
Project administration, scientific publishing (n=2) and student supervision.
Deforestation monitoring in Zambia and Mozambique using satellite time-series.
Organization of training workshop for forest monitoring using satellite data for researchers from BioCarbon Partners.
Workflow development in Google Earth Engine Python using Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, and GEDI data.

volunteer_experience.summary: Deforestation monitoring and forest structure analyses using GEDI, Sentinel-1 and -2.
Tree growth analyses in the dendrochronology laboratory.
Land cover analyses under alpine disturbances using multi-decadal Landsat time-series.
Online cartography of infrastructure data in the Alps.
Laboratory assistant for soil and vegetation analyses, including field work.
